title: Backup-code login skips the password check entirely
description: Password verification at line 121 is gated on `!credentials.totpCode`, and backup-code branch at line 131 runs before TOTP and never re-checks password. Attacker can post empty password with totpCode and backupCode to bypass password verification, turning a second factor into a single-factor credential.

title: Dismissing the backup-codes dialog destroys the only copy of the codes
description: Escape key or outside-click during DisplayBackupCodes step closes modal without calling onEnable(), losing codes permanently with no regenerate endpoint. Also skips invalidation, leaving settings switch reading Disabled while 2FA is on until page reload.

title: `missing_backup_codes` tells users to do something the UI doesn't offer
description: Error message directs users to generate codes in settings, but setup.ts returns TwoFactorAlreadyEnabled for users with existing 2FA. No regenerate endpoint exists, leaving locked-out users in a dead-end loop.

title: `resetState()` leaves backup codes and their blob URL alive for the tab's lifetime
description: resetState() clears password and step but not backupCodes or backupCodesUrl. Plaintext codes remain in React state and object URL stays fetchable by any page script (including XSS on unrelated routes) until full navigation.

title: New backup-code component is named `TwoFactor`
description: Component exports `function TwoFactor()` (leftover from copy-paste). Both this and the real TwoFactor are imported side-by-side, so React DevTools and stack traces show duplicate names, causing debugging confusion.
